title: VEON Sets Out 2030 Growth and Shareholder Return Framework at Capital Markets Day
body_markdown:
16 Nov 2026


#### VEON Sets Out 2030 Growth and Shareholder Return Framework at Capital Markets Day


*Targets 12–15% organic annual growth in USD revenue and EBITDA from 2026 to 2030*
*Targets annual shareholder returns of at least USD 200 million*
*Aspires to reach 50% digital revenue mix*


**Dubai and New York, November 16, 2026 –** VEON Ltd. (Nasdaq: VEON), a global digital operator, today presents its 2030 strategy and financial framework at its Capital Markets Day at the Nasdaq MarketSite in New York.


Under the vision “VEON 2030: A Better Life for All,” the Group has set goals to grow financial and digital services, continue to fortify its telecom businesses and convert growth into higher earnings, cash generation and shareholder returns.


In the first nine months of 2026, VEON generated USD 3.8 billion in revenue, with digital services at 26.5% of revenue over the same period (27.2% in 3Q26). The Group is on track to deliver all five ambitions announced at its 2024 Capital Markets Day, as reflected in the materials. VEON Group CEO Kaan Terzioglu said: *“Our telecom networks and trusted local brands give us a strong foundation. We are building on it with financial services, entertainment, healthcare and other digital services that people use every day. Customers who use more of our services stay with us longer and spend more. The next level of growth will be fueled by a compelling value proposition - a better version of yourself, powered by sovereign augmented intelligence. Our plan through 2030 is to grow these businesses while maintaining discipline over investment and the balance sheet. and to convert that growth into stronger cash generation and lasting value for our shareholders.”*


**2030 Targets**


- Growth: 12–15% organic annual growth in USD revenue and EBITDA, 2026 to 2030
- Earnings and cash flow: earnings per share and free cash flow growing faster than revenue
- Shareholder returns: at least USD 200 million annually, through share buybacks and cancellation
- Balance sheet discipline: net leverage at or below 1.5x, excluding leases


VEON also aspires to increase its mix of digital services to approximately 50% of Group revenue by 2030, from 27.2% in the 3Q26, combining organic growth with selective acquisitions. The Group’s 2030 growth target is on an organic basis.


**Our growth strategy: From connectivity to compounding growth**
Connectivity brings customers in and provides the distribution backbone; each additional digital and financial service deepens engagement and drives further growth. Financial services are expected to be a principal growth engine, building on VEON’s proven model in Pakistan, subject to local licences and market conditions. In telecom, the Group will prioritise data adoption, fixed broadband, operating efficiency and an asset-light approach to infrastructure, guided by customer demand and financial returns. VEON will also continue to strengthen the standalone capabilities of each business making them capable of attracting outside capital.


**NeoV and locally relevant AI**
NeoV brings together VEON’s work in local-language Sovereign AI (Augmented Intelligence), in-country computing and data residency, helping customers, businesses and public institutions use AI suited to their languages and local needs. VEON has launched or is developing national-language models across its markets and embedding AI into its services and operations, and through its AI1440 ambition aims to make AI useful throughout customers’ daily lives.


**A milestone moment**
Today marks a milestone for VEON: three decades as a company listed on the U.S. public markets. To mark the occasion, VEON’s management team will ring the Nasdaq Opening Bell at Nasdaq MarketSite in New York, before presenting the Group’s 2030 strategy at its Capital Markets Day, a fitting moment to look forward as VEON sets out its ambitions for the years ahead.


**Capital Markets Day webcast and materials**
The event will be webcast live from the Nasdaq MarketSite in New York, beginning at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time on November 16, 2026.


The live webcast is available at[CMD webcast page](https://brrmedia.news/VEON_CMD_2026) . Presentation materials and a webcast replay will be available following the event on the CMD website,[veoncmd.com](https://www.veoncmd.com/en) , and at[VEON Investor Relations](https://www.veon.com/investors) .


The CMD website also features VEON CEO’s AI Digital Twin, an interactive experience designed to help visitors explore VEON’s published strategy and CMD materials.


**About VEON**
VEON is a digital operator that provides converged connectivity and digital services to nearly 152 million connectivity and more than 221 million digital users. Operating across five countries that are home to more than 6% of the world’s population, VEON is transforming lives through technology-driven services that empower individuals and drive economic growth. VEON is listed on Nasdaq. For more information, visit[www.veon.com](https://www.veon.com/) .
